zh.name: 曾也鲁
zh.title: 教授 · 博士生导师
zh.tagline: 围绕植被遥感辐射传输建模、植被生理与结构参数反演、植被遥感时空大数据分析开展研究。
zh.bio: 曾也鲁，中国农业大学土地科学与技术学院教授、博士生导师。本科毕业于武汉大学遥感信息工程学院，博士毕业于中国科学院遥感与数字地球研究所。先后在美国斯坦福卡内基全球生态学系、美国西北太平洋国家实验室、美国威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校从事博士后与助理科学家研究。入选国家级高层次青年人才（2022）、《麻省理工科技评论》亚太区"35 岁以下科技创新 35 人"（2022）、中国农业大学杰出人才计划（2021）。研究方向涵盖叶片—冠层—像元多尺度植被荧光/光学辐射传输解析模型、植被生理与结构参数遥感反演、植被遥感时空大数据分析与遥感产品真实性检验。

en.name: Yelu Zeng
en.title: Professor, Ph.D. Supervisor
en.tagline: Radiative transfer modeling, vegetation parameter retrieval, and spatiotemporal big data in vegetation remote sensing.
en.bio: Yelu Zeng is a Professor at the College of Land Science and Technology, China Agricultural University. He received his B.Eng. from Wuhan University and Ph.D. from the Institute of Remote Sensing and Digital Earth, CAS. He was a postdoctoral fellow at the Carnegie Institution for Science (Stanford), PNNL, and UW-Madison. He is a recipient of the National Young Talent Program (2022) and MIT Technology Review Innovators Under 35 (Asia Pacific, 2022). His research focuses on leaf-to-canopy-to-pixel radiative transfer models, vegetation parameter retrieval, and product validation over heterogeneous surfaces.

join.zh: 课题组常年招收对植被遥感、辐射传输建模、遥感大数据感兴趣的博士研究生、硕士研究生与博士后。欢迎具有遥感、地理信息、生态、植物学、计算机、数学等背景的同学报考。有意者请将个人简历、成绩单与代表作发送至 PI 邮箱，邮件标题注明"应聘/报考 + 姓名 + 学位阶段"。
join.en: The group welcomes prospective Ph.D. students, master students and postdocs interested in vegetation remote sensing, radiative transfer modeling, and remote sensing big data. Candidates with backgrounds in remote sensing, GIS, ecology, plant science, CS, or mathematics are encouraged to apply. Please send CV, transcripts and representative publication to PI email with subject "Application + Name + Degree Level".
